about: Curated additions and guards for app/pipeline/skill_evidence.py. The resume skill matcher stays the default; this file only (a) adds skills it cannot see, (b) removes wrong matches, (c) fixes spelling. Alternatives rule: a tool not named in the step title that appears only inside a list of options is excluded; a tool the step teaches (its own topic or the project stack) is kept. Draft - not yet used by any route.

exclude.reason: 'ReAct' is an AI-agent pattern, not the React library (kept if the text also names React itself)
React Native steps teach React Native, not React for the web (kept if the text also names React itself)
'SQL injection' is a security topic, not SQL skill
